overview_description.description: Playgama is a fast-growing distributor of HTML5 games, connecting developers to an audience of 220 million monthly active players. about_short_description.short_description: Playgama is a fast-growing PaaS ecosystem for game developers and a distributor of HTML5 games

product.name: Playgama Gaming Platform
product.description: A browser-based distribution platform offering more than 10,000 HTML5 and WebGL games for desktop, mobile, tablet, and Chromebook users.

product.name: Playgama Bridge SDK
product.description: An open-source SDK that lets developers integrate game services once and distribute HTML5 games across multiple portals, social networks, messengers, and digital platforms.

identifier.value: Playgama Game Distribution and Monetization Service

product.name: Playgama Game Distribution and Monetization Service
product.description: A platform-as-a-service offering that publishes HTML5 games across partner platforms and provides advertising, in-game purchase, analytics, quality assurance, and revenue-sharing infrastructure.

product.name: Playgama Ad
product.description: An advertising service for web games and gaming portals that provides game-specific ad formats, premium demand, and tools for increasing advertising revenue.

product.name: Playgama for Partners
product.description: A partner program that allows gaming portals and apps to integrate pre-screened Playgama games without hosting or developing the games themselves.

product.name: Playgama Games Catalog API
product.description: An API that enables partners to retrieve Playgama game listings and integrate the catalog into their own gaming portals or applications.
